note: One entry per native check binary. A case that is not selected by any profile is an error, not a silent omission: see tests/run-checks.py. `model` profiles are never selected by default because they need an explicitly prepared asset.

selector.note: The umbrella globs every unit case; the tensor-parallel cases need a prepared model, so they are declared in the model profile instead of being silently skipped here.

integration.description: Native integration cases that own their fixture processes; still asset-free.

model.description: Cases that require an explicitly prepared model asset. Never selected by default.
